verification.area: Repository, branch, PR, and source identity
verification.evidence:
The GitHub connector opened chemitaro/spec-dock, found the required branch, and resolved PR #351 head to 1f54950b550dcfac5afc11977985651ae07aa4a7. A final PR metadata recheck returned the same head. No default-branch fallback was used, matching the attached quality-gate identity contract. 

attachments-bundle

The exact comparison from the previous failing head 906ac49f820a2b131bef6a9092789b40896579d9 to the reviewed head is one commit with nine changed files. Runtime changes are limited to provider and dogfood copies of issue_planning_prompt.py and issue_planning_apply.py; the remaining changes are focused tests and review/report evidence.

In src/spec_dock/assets/spec_dock/scripts/spec_dock_runtime/infra/issue_planning_apply.py, _reference_transaction_payloads constructs only three terminal-LF byte sequences: branch-only, HEAD-then-branch, and branch-then-HEAD. The generated prepared-phase hook reads raw stdin bytes, reconstructs the parent-generated closed set from SPECDOCK_EXPECTED_REF_PAYLOADS hex values, and requires direct byte membership. The prior splitlines and blank-record filtering behavior is absent. Symbolic HEAD bytes, HEAD.lock regular-file confirmation, branch CAS, native-hook delegation, and the existing lock path remain in the execution path.

tests/unit/infra/test_issue_planning_apply.py asserts the exact three accepted payloads and rejects representative malformed bytes including missing terminal LF, CRLF, leading or trailing blank records, duplicate or extra records, changed update fields, extra fields, and non-ASCII input. Because acceptance is exact byte-set membership, intermediate blank records and independent old-SHA, new-SHA, or ref-name changes are rejected by the same condition. Existing real-Git publication, resume, branch-lock, CAS, and native reference-transaction delegation tests remain present.

In PlanningOutputExpectation.post_init, the exact suffix -issue-planning-documents.zip is now required before the Issue-ID segment is extracted. The segment is passed to normalize_id_input and must remain byte-for-byte canonical, after which internal_root must equal the validated logical filename without .zip. Bare IDs, missing or altered suffixes, uppercase IDs, noncanonical padding, empty stems, and malformed local IDs cannot pass solely by sharing an internal root.

tests/unit/application/test_issue_planning_prompt.py contains direct negative cases for a bare ID, missing .zip, wrong suffix, uppercase ID, noncanonical numeric padding, empty stem, and malformed local-ID stem. Positive cases retain iss-local-00001-issue-planning-documents.zip and iss-100000-issue-planning-documents.zip with their exact matching roots.

The exact-head Requirement REQ-019 and AC-019 and Design section 4.1 require the exact <issue-id>-issue-planning-documents.zip filename, same-stem root, closed payload inventory, and fail-closed rejection. The remediation implements those constraints without changing the public command family, Candidate controls, Review or Human authority, apply transaction, rollback, or publication semantics.

The GitHub blob SHA for provider and dogfood issue_planning_prompt.py is identical at 915c3704c8db63039c70a15b714d9fa25bb5f0d7. The provider and dogfood issue_planning_apply.py blob SHA is likewise identical at bcdf8431c1c07069c5a14cd5b9b3a2ab6546f633.

The CI and Provider CI workflow runs associated with the reviewed PR head both completed successfully. Provider CI passed Ruff, formatting, and mypy over 287 source files and reported 1420 passed with 2239 skipped on the PR merge commit. The exact-head repository report additionally records 11 focused C/D tests, 360 focused Issue Planning tests, four selected integration tests, 1424 ordinary tests with 2235 skipped, lint, validate with nodes=227, git diff --check, and provider/dogfood parity.

uncertainty: This read-only gate did not independently re-run repository-local commands. The GitHub Actions jobs checked out PR merge commit 90e029a7023fc572dd64b44a803b2a6096f76db1 rather than the source commit directly; the exact-source local test counts are repository-recorded evidence, while the implementation and test files themselves were inspected at source HEAD 1f54950b550dcfac5afc11977985651ae07aa4a7.
